summary.answer: Sets notification container alpha to zero when shoutcaster player notifications are disabled or either demo hidden/moviecam visibility bit is set, otherwise one. Uses the event controller for shoutcaster checks and container controller for visibility bits. Ignores notifications after game end unless play-of-match is set. Assigns configured priority, scans the queue until a lower numeric priority or same-type comparator says insert earlier, inserts at that index and immediately calls ShowNextNotification. Equal priorities otherwise retain the traversal order. Reads scoreInfoIndex, gets medal data, creates a streamed image, tracks it in streamedImages, configures image streaming and binds ready/timeout callbacks. Ready removes tracking and queues a Medal holding the image; timeout removes tracking and closes it. The literal timeout/configuration values and image fields are preserved; no su [excerpt; exact source record identified separately]
